messages:
Aria Lopez: Tiny SEO sync - final pass for the launch post + companion webinar. Need canonical rules, promo redirect plan, simple JSON-LD, and two meta variants. 10 min?

Noah Reed: I can run canonical logic. Rule: /register is primary canonical. /guestlist can self-canonical unless content parity >80% then canonical-> /register.

Zoe Kim: Ill do JSON-LD and OG tags. Will include Event schema and an FAQ block for the webinar page.

Diego Alvarez: Redirects: keep them campaign-safe (302). I'll spin a small nginx snippet and include query-based rollback flags.

Noah Reed: Snippet idea:
```
# campaign redirects
/location/social-cta /guestlist?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=jun_webinar 302
/guestlist/submit /register?utm_source=guestlist_form&utm_campaign=jun_webinar 302
/blog/webinar-2026 /register?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=webinar 301
```
Note: 301 only for permanent archive moves.

Zoe Kim: Tiny JSON-LD sample Ill add to PR: {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference Webinar","startDate":"2026-06-15T17:00:00Z","eventAttendanceMode":"https://schema.org/OnlineEventAttendanceMode","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://www.redwood.com/register"},"offers":{"@type":"Offer","price":"0","priceCurrency":"USD"}}

Diego Alvarez: Internal linking: add a persistent CTA to /guestlist from Docs and Product overview with utm_content indicating variant. 72-hour site banner also.

Aria Lopez: Keywords from benchmark to use in meta and H1 thoughts: "production inference webinar", "inference latency tips". Zoe, leave two meta variants in the content doc and we'll A/B.

Noah Reed: Quick QA plan: run staging crawl after PRs merge, confirm rel=canonical, JSON-LD present, no 4xx on redirects.

seo-bot: Staging crawl scheduled for 2026-04-05T05:00Z. Will post results to #marketing-crawl-results.

Zoe Kim: Ill add a unit test to assert JSON-LD and OG meta tags present.

Diego Alvarez: I'll open the redirect PR with nginx-safe rules and rollback notes.

Aria Lopez: Thanks team 94 reconvene Wed 9am to check crawl. Ping here for blockers. :rocket:
